title: WARPO Trace Point Mapping Schema
description: Schema for multi-module trace point mapping configuration in warpo_trace_visualizer.

items.description: Configuration for a single WebAssembly module trace point mapping.

moduleId.description: The 64-bit module identifier (unsigned integer or decimal/hex string).

oneOf.description: Decimal or hex string representation of module ID (e.g. '1' or '0x10').

mappingFile.description: Path to the trace_points.txt mapping file for this module (absolute or relative to the JSON file).

moduleName.description: Optional custom display name for the module track in Perfetto UI. Defaults to 'Module <moduleId>'.
